name: atlas-late
cmd: set -e; for c in desk_tempho_1995_s1_late desk_tempho_1995_s2_late; do test -f {cache}/$c/esk_epochs.npz || {python} research/exp/esk_project.py --cache {cache}/$c; done; for c in desk_tempho_1995_s1 desk_tempho_1995_s1_late desk_tempho_1995_s2 desk_tempho_1995_s2_late; do mkdir -p {out}/$c; {python} research/exp/atlas.py --cache {cache}/$c --out {out}/$c --population withheld; done
summarize: for c in desk_tempho_1995_s1 desk_tempho_1995_s1_late desk_tempho_1995_s2 desk_tempho_1995_s2_late; do echo == $c; {python} research/exp/atlas.py --summarize {out}/$c | grep -iE 'centered|slope|corr'\|slope\|corr' | head -8; done
note: E025: magnitude half -- centered corr and calibration slope (truth on DESK) of withheld-decade change, selected vs late
